disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了敏感路径读写模式：插件读取 SKILL.md 文件（技能元数据），未读取任何凭据文件（如 .credentials.yaml、~/.ssh、id_rsa、.aws/credentials 等），未发现对密钥、令牌、密码的枚举或访问
checked_items.en: Checked sensitive path read/write patterns: the plugin reads the SKILL.md file (skill metadata), does not read any credential files (such as .credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, id_rsa, .aws/credentials, etc.), and no enumeration or access to keys, tokens, or passwords was found

checked_items.zh: 检查了代码中的凭据读取语义：插件使用文件读取 API 读取技能目录下 SKILL.md 的前导元数据（名称和描述），属于插件核心功能的正常文件读取；读取 DSH_HOME 环境变量仅用于定位技能目录，非凭据访问
checked_items.en: Checked credential-reading semantics in the code: the plugin uses file read APIs to read the leading metadata (name and description) of SKILL.md in the skill directory, which is normal file reading for the plugin's core functionality; reading the DSH_HOME environment variable is only used to locate the skill directory, not for credential access

checked_items.zh: 检查了钱包/金融资产相关模式：未发现助记词、私钥遍历、签名交易等钱包相关代码
checked_items.en: Checked wallet/financial asset related patterns: no wallet-related code such as mnemonic phrases, private key traversal, or transaction signing was found

evidence.zh: 插件扫描技能目录时只读取 SKILL.md 文件的前导元数据，不读取任何凭据或敏感文件；扫描路径限于技能目录（$DSH_HOME/skills、.dsh/skills、.agents/skills），未触及 .credentials.yaml、~/.ssh 等敏感路径；无凭据读取行为，外联通道为空（无外部网络调用）
evidence.en: When scanning the skill directory, the plugin only reads the leading metadata of SKILL.md files and does not read any credentials or sensitive files; the scan path is limited to the skill directory ($DSH_HOME/skills, .dsh/skills, .agents/skills) and does not touch sensitive paths such as .credentials.yaml or ~/.ssh; no credential-reading behavior, and the outbound channel is empty (no external network calls)

checked_items.zh: 检查了静态文本面注入：插件通过系统提示段接口注册了一个名为 plugin:skill-picker 的提示段，经语义审查确认其内容为中文功能描述，说明本机已安装该插件、技能选择按钮的位置、/技能名 手势的调用机制，以及用户常用语对应关系；内容无系统指令覆写、无凭据读取诱导、无安装引导、无远程指令加载。该命中经裁决为良性：系统提示段机制本身是 DSH 的合法能力，此处用法是插件对自身功能的自我描述，与声明的业务自洽
checked_items.en: Checked static text-surface injection: the plugin registered a prompt section named plugin:skill-picker via the system prompt section interface. Semantic review confirmed its content is a Chinese functional description, explaining that the plugin is installed locally, the location of the skill selection button, the invocation mechanism of the /skill-name gesture, and the correspondence of commonly used user phrases; the content has no system instruction override, no credential-reading inducement, no installation guidance, and no remote instruction loading. This hit was adjudicated as benign: the system prompt section mechanism itself is a legitimate capability of DSH, and the usage here is the plugin's self-description of its own functionality, which is consistent with its declared business

checked_items.zh: 检查了运行消息面注入：插件未监听 agent/pre-step 事件，未在运行时改写或注入模型输入消息
checked_items.en: Checked runtime message-surface injection: the plugin does not listen to the agent/pre-step event and does not rewrite or inject model input messages at runtime

checked_items.zh: 检查了上下文历史压缩面：插件未实现压缩引擎（无 CompactionEngine 子类），无法控制上下文压力下的历史存留与摘要改写
checked_items.en: Checked the context history compaction surface: the plugin does not implement a compaction engine (no CompactionEngine subclass), so it cannot control history retention and summary rewriting under context pressure

checked_items.zh: 检查了工具描述投毒面：插件未注册任何工具（无工具注册调用），仅注册了 webServer 路由和系统提示段，工具描述投毒不适用
checked_items.en: Checked the tool description poisoning surface: the plugin does not register any tools (no tool registration calls), only registers webServer routes and system prompt sections, so tool description poisoning is not applicable

evidence.zh: 静态扫描命中规则 DSH-T02（对应报告规则 DG-R2-52）：lib/index.js:72 和 src/index.js:119 调用了 ctx.systemPrompt.section() 注册提示段。经语义审查，注入的提示段内容为插件功能说明性文本（关于技能选择器的使用方式与 /技能名 手势机制），不包含系统指令、凭据读取诱导或隐藏意图，属于合法的插件自我描述，未构成提示词注入；插件未注册任何工具，故无工具描述投毒面
evidence.en: Static scan hit rule DSH-T02 (corresponding to report rule DG-R2-52): lib/index.js:72 and src/index.js:119 call ctx.systemPrompt.section() to register prompt sections. After semantic review, the injected prompt section content is plugin functionality descriptive text (about the usage of the skill picker and the /skill-name gesture mechanism), which does not contain system instructions, credential-reading inducement, or hidden intent. It is a legitimate plugin self-description and does not constitute prompt injection; the plugin does not register any tools, so there is no tool description poisoning surface

evidence.zh: 审查了全部系统提示段和客户端文本，未发现诱导用户安装其他插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；插件仅描述自身功能，不涉及安装引导或配置篡改诱导
evidence.en: Reviewed all system prompt sections and client-side text; no wording inducing users to install other plugins, modify configuration, or relax permissions was found; the plugin only describes its own functionality and does not involve installation guidance or configuration tampering inducement

evidence.zh: 未监听 agent/pre-step 事件，代码中无任何对 agent/pre-step 的 on/prepend/once 注册调用，不涉及模型输入消息的运行时改写或注入
evidence.en: Does not listen to the agent/pre-step event; the code has no on/prepend/once registration calls for agent/pre-step, and does not involve runtime rewriting or injection of model input messages

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载配置中的 js 标量：cordis.patch.yml 仅含简单的 - insert 行（id 和 name），无 !!js 或 !!js/function 标量，不存在配置加载即执行的代码执行风险
checked_items.en: Checked the js scalars in the patch config: cordis.patch.yml only contains simple - insert lines (id and name), with no !!js or !!js/function scalars, so there is no risk of code execution upon config loading

checked_items.zh: 检查了动态包工具调用：未发现 cordis_define 或 cordis_run 调用，无 node:vm 代码执行面
checked_items.en: Checked dynamic package tool invocation: no cordis_define or cordis_run calls found, and no node:vm code execution surface

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装钩子：package.json 中 scripts 仅有 build 命令，无 preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 钩子
checked_items.en: Checked install hooks: the scripts in package.json only contain the build command, with no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare hooks

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端 bundle 异常行为：lib/client.js 构建产物经审查，无键盘监听、剪贴板访问、凭据 RPC 调用或可疑外联；仅使用 fetch 调用本机路由 /dsh-skill-picker/skills，使用 localStorage 记录技能使用频率，使用输入框写入接口插入文本，均为正常浏览器 UI 行为
checked_items.en: Checked the browser-side bundle for abnormal behavior: the built artifact lib/client.js was reviewed; no keyboard listeners, clipboard access, credential RPC calls, or suspicious outbound connections; it only uses fetch to call the local route /dsh-skill-picker/skills, uses localStorage to record skill usage frequency, and uses an input box write interface to insert text, all of which are normal browser UI behaviors

checked_items.zh: 检查了子代理委派和持驻注册：未发现子代理提供方注册、后台任务、定时任务、持久目标注册调用，未监听轮次终止事件
checked_items.en: Checked sub-agent delegation and persistent registration: no sub-agent provider registration, background tasks, scheduled tasks, persistent goal registration calls, and no listening to round termination events were found

checked_items.zh: 检查了危险函数与混淆信号：未发现 eval、new Function、child_process、execSync、spawn 等危险函数调用（仅使用标准库的文件读取、目录读取、路径与系统信息模块）。两处转义密度信号（规则 DSH-X08，对应报告规则 DG-R3-60）经逐条裁决为构建产物的正常行为——lib/client.js 中的字符映射表是模糊搜索库的正常数据表，lib/index.js 中的中文提示文字是构建工具对非 ASCII 字符的编码方式，两者均非第一方故意混淆，按规则豁免，不产出发现项
checked_items.en: Checked dangerous functions and obfuscation signals: no calls to dangerous functions such as eval, new Function, child_process, execSync, spawn were found (only standard library file read, directory read, path, and system information modules are used). Two escape density signals (rule DSH-X08, corresponding to report rule DG-R3-60) were adjudicated case by case as normal behavior of build artifacts — the character mapping table in lib/client.js is a normal data table of the fuzzy search library, and the Chinese prompt text in lib/index.js is the build tool's encoding of non-ASCII characters. Both are not first-party intentional obfuscation and are exempted per the rules, producing no findings

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 仅含 - insert 行（id 和 name），无 !!js 或 !!js/function 标量；全树扫描所有 yml 文件无命中，不存在配置加载时执行任意 JS 的风险
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml only contains - insert lines (id and name), with no !!js or !!js/function scalars; full-tree scan of all yml files shows no hits, so there is no risk of executing arbitrary JS during config loading

evidence.zh: 未使用 cordis_define 或 cordis_run 动态包工具，代码中无对 node:vm 的调用，不涉及自我修改滥用
evidence.en: Does not use the cordis_define or cordis_run dynamic package tools; the code has no calls to node:vm, so self-modification abuse is not involved

evidence.zh: package.json 中 scripts 仅有 build 命令，无 preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 安装钩子；无 .husky 目录、lefthook.yml、.devcontainer、Makefile、.github/workflows 等树内执行载体。两处转义密度信号（规则 DSH-X08，对应报告规则 DG-R3-60，位于 lib/client.js:1377 与 lib/index.js:7）经裁决均为构建产物正常行为：前者是打包进 bundle 的模糊搜索库字符映射表，后者是中文说明文字经构建工具编码，均非混淆或动态解码执行，按规则豁免
evidence.en: The scripts in package.json only contain the build command, with no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare install hooks; there is no .husky directory, lefthook.yml, .devcontainer, Makefile, .github/workflows, or other in-tree execution carriers. Two escape density signals (rule DSH-X08, corresponding to report rule DG-R3-60, located at lib/client.js:1377 and lib/index.js:7) were both adjudicated as normal behavior of build artifacts: the former is the character mapping table of the fuzzy search library bundled into the bundle, and the latter is Chinese descriptive text encoded by the build tool; neither is obfuscation or dynamic decoding execution, and they are exempted per the rules

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端 bundle（自动加载），经审查 lib/client.js 构建产物：无键盘事件监听、无剪贴板访问、无凭据 RPC 调用、无可疑外联（仅 fetch 调用本机路由 /dsh-skill-picker/skills），浏览器半区行为正常
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side bundle (auto-loaded). The built artifact lib/client.js was reviewed: no keyboard event listeners, no clipboard access, no credential RPC calls, and no suspicious outbound connections (only fetch calls to the local route /dsh-skill-picker/skills). The browser half-side behavior is normal

evidence.zh: 未调用子代理提供方注册接口，代码中无相关调用，不涉及把轮次委派给进程外代理产品
evidence.en: Does not call the sub-agent provider registration interface; the code has no related calls, so delegating rounds to out-of-process agent products is not involved

evidence.zh: 未使用后台任务、定时任务、持久目标等 dsh 原生持驻机制；未监听 agent/turn-stopping 事件，不存在让本应结束的轮次续命的行为
evidence.en: Does not use native DSH persistence mechanisms such as background tasks, scheduled tasks, or persistent goals; does not listen to the agent/turn-stopping event, so there is no behavior that keeps an otherwise-ending round alive

checked_items.zh: 检查了外联端点：插件仅通过 fetch 访问本机路由 /dsh-skill-picker/skills，未向任何外部域名或 IP 发起网络请求；未使用 curl/wget 命令；无 WebSocket 连接
checked_items.en: Checked outbound endpoints: the plugin only uses fetch to access the local route /dsh-skill-picker/skills and makes no network requests to any external domain or IP; no curl/wget commands; no WebSocket connections

checked_items.zh: 检查了 LLM 路由劫持面：未监听 agent/request 或 agent/request-error 事件，未调用适配器注册接口，不存在模型路由劫持或错误恢复接管风险
checked_items.en: Checked the LLM routing hijack surface: does not listen to agent/request or agent/request-error events, does not call adapter registration interfaces, and there is no risk of model routing hijack or error recovery takeover

evidence.zh: 插件无外部网络调用，不获取凭据文件，不存在凭据读取加外发的组合链；宿主沙箱无网络闸的生态固有风险在本插件中不成立（插件本身无任何外联行为）
evidence.en: The plugin has no external network calls and does not fetch credential files, so the combined chain of credential reading plus exfiltration does not exist; the ecosystem inherent risk of the host sandbox lacking a network gate does not apply to this plugin (the plugin itself has no outbound behavior)

evidence.zh: 未监听 agent/request 或 agent/request-error 事件，未注册自定义模型适配器；代码中无相关规则（DSH-L01/L02/L06）的任何命中，不涉及 LLM 路由运行时劫持或错误恢复接管
evidence.en: Does not listen to agent/request or agent/request-error events, does not register custom model adapters; the code has no hits for the related rules (DSH-L01/L02/L06), so runtime hijacking of LLM routing or error recovery takeover is not involved

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载配置对安全配置的影响：cordis.patch.yml 仅插入插件行，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置字段，未含禁用或降权写法，未改写注入/拦截配置
checked_items.en: Checked the impact of the patch config on security configuration: cordis.patch.yml only inserts the plugin line and does not touch security configuration fields such as sandbox, approval, or permissions; it does not contain disabling or privilege-lowering entries, and does not rewrite injection/interception configuration

checked_items.zh: 检查了安全事件瀑布截断：未发现对工具执行前或审批请求等安全事件的置顶监听，不存在截断审批链风险
checked_items.en: Checked waterfall truncation of security events: no prepend listeners on security events such as pre-tool-execution or approval requests were found, so there is no risk of truncating the approval chain

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖与身份：对等依赖指向 @deepseek-ai/* 官方包，开发依赖 fuzzysort 为知名模糊搜索库，版本范围合理；作者 GitHub 账号无历史记录（未验证），按规则仅作身份加权，不单独判定风险
checked_items.en: Checked dependencies and identity: the peer dependency points to an official @deepseek-ai/* package, and the dev dependency fuzzysort is a well-known fuzzy search library with a reasonable version range; the author's GitHub account has no historical record (unverified), which is only used as an identity weighting per the rules and is not independently judged as a risk

checked_items.zh: 首次审计，无版本基线可比较，升级自动激活场景不适用
checked_items.en: First-time audit, no version baseline to compare, upgrade auto-activation scenario not applicable

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 仅含 - insert 行（id 和 name），不包含沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置字段，不修改任何安全行的禁用或模式值，不存在挂载配置覆盖安全行的风险
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml only contains - insert lines (id and name), does not include security configuration fields such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, does not modify the disabled or mode values of any security lines, and there is no risk of the patch config overriding security lines

evidence.zh: 未对工具执行前或审批请求等 waterfall 安全事件进行置顶监听，不存在监听者不调用回调即截断审批链的行为
evidence.en: Does not prepend listeners on waterfall security events such as pre-tool-execution or approval requests, so there is no behavior where a listener truncates the approval chain without calling the callback

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无此前版本报告可比较版本基线，无法评估升级后自动获得入层声明的场景
evidence.en: First-time audit, no previous version report to compare version baseline, so the scenario of automatically gaining entry-layer declarations after an upgrade cannot be assessed

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 未改写注入或拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加不存在的必需服务使其永久等待的风险
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml does not rewrite injection or interception configuration, so there is no risk of adding a non-existent required service to a security plugin that makes it wait indefinitely

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件 web 服务注册：插件通过 webServer 接口注册了 /dsh-skill-picker 路由，用于返回技能目录列表。该路由只读取技能元数据并返回 JSON，不涉及敏感操作。DSH 生态中 webserver 无认证/TLS 属宿主固有风险，非本插件特有，本插件未在其上叠加额外风险面
checked_items.en: Checked the plugin web service registration: the plugin registers the /dsh-skill-picker route via the webServer interface to return the skill directory list. This route only reads skill metadata and returns JSON, involving no sensitive operations. In the DSH ecosystem, webserver without authentication/TLS is an inherent host risk, not specific to this plugin; this plugin does not add an additional risk surface on top of it

evidence.zh: 插件注册了 /dsh-skill-picker 路由，返回技能元数据（名称、描述、路径）。该路由经宿主 webserver 暴露，DSH 生态本身无认证/TLS（已知宿主固有风险），但本插件未增加额外风险面：路由只读、不写、不执行命令、不暴露凭据；返回的技能目录路径仅对本地可达，属轻微信息暴露，按定级纪律不构成发现项
evidence.en: The plugin registers the /dsh-skill-picker route, returning skill metadata (name, description, path). This route is exposed via the host webserver, and the DSH ecosystem itself has no authentication/TLS (known inherent host risk), but this plugin does not add an additional risk surface: the route is read-only, does not write, does not execute commands, and does not expose credentials; the returned skill directory paths are only reachable locally, which is a minor information exposure and, per adjudication discipline, does not constitute a finding

summary.zh: 元数据与身份校验通过：插件包含有效的 dsh 声明（挂载配置 + 浏览器端声明），作者身份未验证（仅加权），无品牌仿冒嫌疑
summary.en: Metadata and identity validation passed: the plugin contains valid DSH declarations (patch config + browser-side declaration); author identity is not verified (only weighted), and there is no suspicion of brand impersonation

summary.zh: 静态扫描 4 条命中逐条裁决完毕：DSH-T02（DG-R2-52，lib/index.js:72 与 src/index.js:119）的系统提示段注入经语义审查为良性功能描述，不构成提示词注入；DSH-X08（DG-R3-60，lib/client.js:1377 与 lib/index.js:7）两处转义密度命中均为构建产物正常行为，按规则豁免。均无发现项
summary.en: Static scan of 4 hits adjudicated case by case: the system prompt section injection of DSH-T02 (DG-R2-52, lib/index.js:72 and src/index.js:119) was adjudicated after semantic review as a benign functional description and does not constitute prompt injection; the two escape density hits of DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60, lib/client.js:1377 and lib/index.js:7) are both normal behavior of build artifacts and are exempted per the rules. None produce findings

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无安装钩子，无混淆代码，无凭据文件读取，无外部网络外联，无隐蔽下载执行
summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: no install hooks, no obfuscated code, no credential file reads, no external network exfiltration, and no covert download-and-execute

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：系统提示段经语义审查确认为良性功能描述，无提示词注入风险；未注册工具，无工具描述与参数污染面；能力声明与实测一致
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: the system prompt section was semantically reviewed and confirmed to be a benign functional description with no prompt injection risk; no tools registered, so no tool description or parameter contamination surface; capability declarations match actual measurements
